mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) above 1380 thousand units signals strong housing market activity, which typically precedes higher consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1380, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 114.0 and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5 signals a weakening manufacturing sector and labor market, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 114.0 and UNRATE > 4.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high labor market slack (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) signals weakening job creation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 208.0 indicates accelerating inflation, which typically leads to higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 208.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential investment (RSAFS) falls below 370,000 million dollars, it signals a contraction in housing finance, which typically precedes reduced consumer confidence and lower corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 370000, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) below 1380 and rise in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 208.5 indicates a weakening housing market and rising cost of living, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1380 and CPIAUCSL > 208.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 114.0), a decline in industrial production growth signals a deepening supply-side contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 114.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
